method: Proposed Partner IQ model based on interview notes plus current public Blue Origin relationships and programs

accounts.name: Amazon Leo / Project Kuiper
accounts.thesis: Anchor constellation demand with repeat launch capacity and long-range manifest planning.
accounts.signal: Blue Origin lists Amazon Leo among New Glenn customers.

accounts.name: NASA
accounts.program: Blue Moon + Blue Ring + New Glenn
accounts.thesis: Expand from individual programs into reusable infrastructure relationships across Moon, Mars, launch and LEO.
accounts.signal: Blue Origin has active NASA relationships across New Glenn, Blue Moon, LEO destinations, Stennis testing and Mars telecom.

accounts.name: United Launch Alliance
accounts.thesis: Deepen merchant propulsion economics and production alignment around Vulcan cadence.
accounts.signal: ULA and Blue Origin jointly funded BE-4 development and maintain a production relationship.

accounts.name: Air Liquide
accounts.thesis: Orbital cryogenic refueling JV combining Blue Origin mobility and flight infrastructure with industrial gas processing expertise.
accounts.signal: Interview notes identify industrial gas companies as the strongest cryogenic-refueling JV category.

accounts.name: Linde
accounts.thesis: Co-develop orbital LH2/LOX processing and storage infrastructure with per-kg service economics.
accounts.signal: Interview notes identify Linde as a top orbital-propellant infrastructure target.

accounts.name: Sierra Space
accounts.thesis: Continue shared destination architecture around transportation, habitation and commercial LEO services.
accounts.signal: Blue Origin identifies Sierra Space as a principal Orbital Reef partner.

accounts.name: Lockheed Martin
accounts.thesis: Expand National Team collaboration and evaluate Blue Ring / defense integrations where strategic.
accounts.signal: Lockheed Martin is part of Blue Origin's current Sustaining Lunar Development National Team.

accounts.name: Boeing
accounts.thesis: Use existing lunar and LEO collaboration as a base for deeper program-level commercial structures.
accounts.signal: Boeing appears on both the Blue Moon National Team and Orbital Reef team.

accounts.name: Eli Lilly
accounts.thesis: Create an automated microgravity research and protein-crystallization platform with recurring rack economics.
accounts.signal: Interview notes identify Lilly as a high-value microgravity biolab partner category.

accounts.name: Merck
accounts.thesis: Structure a microgravity drug-formulation SPV with shared research infrastructure and recurring access.
accounts.signal: Interview notes identify Merck as a top pharmaceutical SPV target.

accounts.name: AST SpaceMobile
accounts.thesis: Convert current launch relationship into longer-term constellation replenishment and adjacent connectivity collaboration.
accounts.signal: AST SpaceMobile has a multi-launch agreement with New Glenn and flew on NG-3 in 2026.

accounts.name: Caterpillar
accounts.thesis: Co-develop lunar excavation, regolith handling and power infrastructure around an industrial-services model.
accounts.signal: Interview notes position Caterpillar as the highest-value lunar industrial SPV thesis.

accounts.name: Redwire Space
accounts.thesis: Expand research-payload and in-space manufacturing capabilities inside a commercial destination ecosystem.
accounts.signal: Blue Origin lists Redwire as an Orbital Reef team member focused on microgravity R&D and payload operations.

accounts.name: U.S. Space Force / DIU
accounts.thesis: Scale Blue Ring mobility, SDA and infrastructure missions while New Glenn expands national-security launch capacity.
accounts.signal: Blue Ring's DarkSky-1 work is DIU-sponsored and Blue Origin is pursuing NSSL certification for New Glenn.

accounts.name: SES
accounts.thesis: Multi-launch and direct-to-orbit capacity plus potential network-resilience alignment with TeraWave.
accounts.signal: Interview notes rank SES as a high-fit commercial satellite operator.

accounts.name: ESA
accounts.thesis: Blue Moon cargo, lunar access and LEO destination participation for European missions and industry.
accounts.signal: Interview notes identify ESA as a priority international-agency account.

accounts.name: JAXA
accounts.thesis: Lunar cargo, surface power and exploration infrastructure around sustained Artemis participation.
accounts.signal: Interview notes identify JAXA as a priority lunar cargo and power account.

accounts.name: Scout Space
accounts.thesis: Turn first-mission sensor integration into a repeatable hosted-payload and SDA services relationship.
accounts.signal: Scout Space's Owl sensor is integrated on Blue Ring's first mission.

accounts.name: Telesat
accounts.thesis: Use multi-year launch capacity and milestone-linked incentives to diversify constellation launch supply.
accounts.signal: Interview notes identify Telesat Lightspeed as a priority capacity-reservation thesis.

accounts.name: Draper
accounts.thesis: Deepen guidance, navigation and mission-system collaboration across sustained lunar missions.
accounts.signal: Draper is part of Blue Origin's Sustaining Lunar Development National Team.

accounts.name: Optimum Technologies
accounts.thesis: Expand Caracal integration into a commercial GEO tracking and characterization service model.
accounts.signal: OpTech's Caracal sensor is scheduled on Blue Ring's first mission.

accounts.name: John Deere
accounts.thesis: Adapt autonomous heavy-equipment, excavation and operations expertise to lunar construction and resource handling.
accounts.signal: Interview notes identify heavy-equipment partners including John Deere for lunar surface infrastructure.

accounts.name: Eutelsat / OneWeb
accounts.thesis: Replenishment launch capacity and strategic network-resilience opportunities.
accounts.signal: Interview notes identify Eutelsat OneWeb as a commercial constellation target.

accounts.name: Amazon Web Services
accounts.thesis: Extend cloud and edge-compute integration across LEO destination and Blue Ring infrastructure services.
accounts.signal: AWS is listed as an Orbital Reef team member.

accounts.name: Astrobotic
accounts.thesis: Expand sustained lunar-delivery and surface-system integration opportunities.
accounts.signal: Astrobotic is part of Blue Origin's Sustaining Lunar Development National Team.

accounts.name: Microsoft
accounts.thesis: Enterprise connectivity and edge-cloud integration for critical operations using TeraWave and Blue Ring infrastructure.
accounts.signal: TeraWave targets enterprise, data center and government users; Microsoft is an illustrative partner thesis.

accounts.name: Equinix
accounts.thesis: Integrate TeraWave as route-diverse critical connectivity into global data-center interconnection.
accounts.signal: TeraWave is purpose-built for enterprise and data-center users; Equinix is an illustrative target thesis.

accounts.name: UAE Space Agency / MBRSC
accounts.thesis: Sovereign astronaut access, research modules and launch services with potential co-investment structures.
accounts.signal: Interview notes identify UAE / MBRSC as a sovereign-space partnership target.

accounts.name: Viasat
accounts.thesis: Heavy launch plus resilient connectivity alignment for commercial and government communications.
accounts.signal: Interview notes identify Viasat among high-fit commercial satellite operators.

accounts.name: Google Cloud
accounts.thesis: Cloud, AI and edge-processing integration into enterprise connectivity and in-space computing services.
accounts.signal: TeraWave and Blue Ring both create cloud / edge integration surfaces; Google Cloud is an illustrative target thesis.

accounts.name: Pfizer
accounts.thesis: Microgravity formulation and crystallization research with recurring lab-access economics.
accounts.signal: Expanded from the pharmaceutical partner category in the interview notes.

accounts.name: Roche
accounts.thesis: Commercial microgravity research infrastructure for biologics, formulation and materials science.
accounts.signal: Expanded from the pharmaceutical partner category in the interview notes.

accounts.name: Amazon Supply Chain
accounts.thesis: Use terrestrial logistics expertise to design scalable destination resupply and inventory operations.
accounts.signal: Amazon Supply Chain is listed as an Orbital Reef team member.

accounts.name: Digital Realty
accounts.thesis: Global data-center connectivity and critical-network resilience using TeraWave route diversity.
accounts.signal: TeraWave explicitly targets data-center and critical operations users; Digital Realty is an illustrative thesis.

accounts.name: Genesis Engineering Solutions
accounts.thesis: Continue specialized crew and destination-system development within the LEO ecosystem.
accounts.signal: Genesis Engineering Solutions is listed as an Orbital Reef team member.

accounts.name: DLR
accounts.thesis: Expand microgravity research and destination participation with German institutional and industrial ecosystems.
accounts.signal: Interview notes identify DLR as a priority international-agency account; Blue Origin has flown DLR-funded New Shepard payloads.

accounts.name: Saudi Space Agency
accounts.thesis: Sovereign astronaut, research and launch access structured around long-term national capability building.
accounts.signal: Interview notes identify Saudi Space Agency as a sovereign-space partnership target.

accounts.name: NASA Stennis Space Center
accounts.thesis: Use public infrastructure partnerships to deconflict launch operations and accelerate high-cadence test throughput.
accounts.signal: Blue Origin and NASA signed a 2026 agreement to use Stennis' B-Test Complex for New Glenn upper-stage testing.

accounts.name: Arizona State University
accounts.thesis: Use the university consortium model to seed research demand and institutional adoption of commercial LEO.
accounts.signal: ASU leads the Orbital Reef university advisory group.
